Terms and Conditions
SINGLE ROOM POLICY: Maximum of 3 single rooms per group at a single room rate, any additional
single rooms request will be charged at 80% double rate.
Release periods:
• Low season: 30 days
• High season: 45 days
CANCELLATION POLICY:
1. For accommodation cancelled or reduced in number between 45-30 days from noon on the date
of Check in - 15% of the rate applicable per room night cancelled.
2. For accommodation cancelled or reduced in number between 29-20 days from noon on the date
of Check in - 25% of the rate applicable per room night cancelled.
3. For accommodation cancelled or reduced in number between 19-15 days from noon on the date
of Check in - 50% of the rate applicable per room night cancelled.
4. In case of cancellation less than 14 days from noon on the date of Check in, or in case of No-
show – 100% of the net value of the booking.
DISPUTE: Any dispute regarding an invoice, must be received by (Hotels) credit department within 14
days of the date of invoice, and only the amount in dispute may be deducted from the payment of that
invoice.
DEFAULT – Default of undisputed payment may result in the “Agent” clients being refused admittance
to the hotel until payment is made. Payments must be made before guest arrival.
Force Majeure: Elmer Resort & Spa Naivasha will not be liable to pay compensation for changes due to
unforeseen circumstances beyond our control for example fire, flood, natural disaster, industrial
disputes, bad weather or terrorist activity.
INSURANCE: The Agent with its distribution partners to ensure those guests arriving through them is
covered by a fully comprehensive travel insurance policy before travel for cancellation, medical
expense, personal baggage and money.
CONFIDENTIALITY: The operator confirms and agrees that this Agreement is confidential to the
operator and Elmer Resort & Spa and the operator shall not in any circumstance divulge or permit to be
divulged this Agreement or its comments to any person
VARIATION: Rates are inclusive of all Government taxes and levies. Rates are subject to change without
prior notice In the event of any change of Government taxes.
BANKING DETAILS:
All payments made via bank must be made to the below accounts:
